body: ### Thanks to TheBigPeezy and jarrodjabonillo for supporting the project! ❤️ ### Changes Fix release notes appearing every time **I am working for better support for everyone to write and contribute plugins!** ### Installation **Windows** Download the .msi or NSIS setup .exe, or the portable .exe (no install needed). macOS: download the Apple Silicon .dmg for M-series Macs or the Intel .dmg for older Intel Macs. **Linux** You might have to **reinstall the app for things to work**! Linux users with Nix can install the flake directly: ```bash nix profile install github:2latemc/JustAnotherMusicClient ``` **macOS notice** Because the macOS build is not notarized, you may need to open System Settings, go to Privacy & Security, and click Open Anyway after trying to launch the app for the first time. macOS may also show a Keychain access popup. The app stores one encryption key in its own Keychain entry. Your YouTube session is encrypted with that key before it is saved in the app data directory. This popup is expected.

name: v0.1.2 is out | Queue Panel, Liked Songs, Reorder Playlists, Update Notification, Autostart option, Potato PC mode, Remove from Playlist, Still no MacOS & Linux unfortunatelly
body: ## Join the reddit for updates: https://www.reddit.com/r/JustAnotherMusicC/ Desktop installers for Just Another Music Client. Hey everyone! A new update is out **for Windows only.** I am working hard to make Linux & MacOS work. The status is as follows: Everything works on both platforms without issues, a linux fork is there that works well, same for MacOS. The only issue is, that there is a playback bug, that I am unable to resolve. This is my main priority and I will fix this in the coming days. All other Features already work on both platforms. **Extra Features** - Liked songs You can like, unlike songs. Then you can play your liked songs in the albums tab. Liked songs will also be liked on the actual YouTube Music account. - **Discord RPC** **- Reordering Playlists** You can reorder playlists & albums by dragging them - The Queue Tab You can view your Queued songs, reorder them, add new ones. You can open and close the Queue Tab with the button located on the bottom that appears when hovering over the Volume bar. - Shuffle Controls You can switch between loop shuffle and play in order. These controls only appear when you hover over them, close to the volume bar - Update notifications The client should notify you about new updates, I have not tested this yet. - Startup option An option to launch the client on start - Removing songs from playlists You can remove songs from playlists by right-clicking them. They will also be removed from your official Youtube Music playlist. - Portable Build A portable build has been added for windows Get it here: [Releases · 2latemc/JustAnotherMusicClient](https://github.com/2latemc/JustAnotherMusicClient/releases) Windows: download the `.msi` or NSIS setup `.exe`, or the portable `.exe` (no install needed). macOS: download the Apple Silicon `.dmg` for M-series Macs or the Intel `.dmg` for older Intel Macs. ## macOS notice Because the macOS build is not notarized, you may need to open System Settings, go to Privacy & Security, and click **Open Anyway** after trying to launch the app for the first time. macOS may also show a Keychain access popup. The app stores one encryption key in its own Keychain entry. Your YouTube session is encrypted with that key before it is saved in the app data directory. This popup is expected.
